<?php
// Dynamically determine the user and repo if possible
// (Fallbacks for when placeholders aren't yet replaced)
$user = 'Agressiva86';
$repo = 'playground-test';

// 1. Download the ZIP
$zip_url = "https://github.com/$user/$repo/archive/refs/heads/main.zip";
$zip_content = @file_get_contents($zip_url);
if (!$zip_content) return;

file_put_contents('/tmp/repo.zip', $zip_content);

// 2. Extract the ZIP
$zip = new ZipArchive;
if ($zip->open('/tmp/repo.zip') === TRUE) {
    $zip->extractTo('/tmp/extracted');
    $zip->close();

    // 3. Find the theme folder
    $extracted_dirs = glob('/tmp/extracted/*', GLOB_ONLYDIR);
    if (empty($extracted_dirs)) return;
    
    $source_dir = $extracted_dirs[0] . '/theme';
    $dest_dir = '/var/www/html/wp-content/themes/playground-test-theme';

    if (!is_dir($source_dir)) return;

    // 4. Create destination and copy files
    if (!file_exists($dest_dir)) mkdir($dest_dir, 0777, true);
    
    $it = new RecursiveIteratorIterator(new RecursiveDirectoryIterator($source_dir, RecursiveDirectoryIterator::SKIP_DOTS), RecursiveIteratorIterator::SELF_FIRST);
    foreach ($it as $file) {
        $target = $dest_dir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . $it->getSubPathName();
        if ($file->isDir()) {
            if (!file_exists($target)) mkdir($target);
        } else {
            copy($file->getRealPath(), $target);
        }
    }
} ?>
